aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A newly single man living on his own begins recording his sleepwalking episodes, only to uncover disturbing nighttime behavior and a chilling unknown figure in his home.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Following a recent separation, a man adjusting to life on his own discovers that he has developed a troubling sleepwalking habit. To monitor his nocturnal actions, he sets up cameras around his home, expecting simple restlessness. Instead, the footage reveals increasingly erratic behaviors and the unsettling presence of a mysterious figure watching him in the dark. Driven to paranoia, he must uncover whether the threat is a manifestation of his psychological trauma or something far more sinister.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Reeling from the emotional fallout of a recent separation, a man moves into a new home to rebuild his life in solitude. Soon after settling in, he suspects he is sleepwalking when he begins waking up in strange locations around the house with no memory of how he got there. Seeking answers and peace of mind, he installs night-vision cameras to record his slumber. Reviewing the footage, he is horrified to see himself engaging in disturbing, inexplicable behaviors throughout the night. As the nights progress, the recordings capture something even more alarming: a shadowy, unidentified figure lurking in the darkness alongside him. The line between reality and hallucination rapidly blurs as his sleep deprivation and isolation deepen. Unable to trust his own senses or his nocturnal actions, he desperately tries to unravel the mystery of the intruder. Every night brings heightened peril as the entity becomes bolder and more intrusive. Ultimately, he is forced to confront the dark truth lurking within his new home and his unraveling mind before his night terrors consume him completely.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Struggling with the emotional aftermath of a recent separation, a man attempts a fresh start by moving into a new home alone. However, his quiet routine is quickly disrupted when he suspects he is sleepwalking, waking up disoriented and finding items misplaced. To investigate his nocturnal habits, he installs security cameras throughout the house. What begins as a practical attempt to understand his restless sleep rapidly devolves into a nightmare when the footage reveals unexplainable nighttime behaviors and a lingering, mysterious figure. As tension and horror build, this eerie tale explores themes of isolation, psychological distress, and dread in a suspenseful, spoiler-free narrative.

story_structure.risingAction: As he reviews the footage, his sleepwalking behaviors become increasingly unsettling, blurring the line between his conscious actions and his nocturnal state as the mysterious figure draws closer.
